# Molekulimeister

> Molekulimeister helps you explore and understand chemical structures and reactions interactively.

## Core Features / Products
- [Molekulimeister Valmis](https://moleculemaster.eu/): Start using the Molekulimeister platform to educate yourself on molecular structures.
- [Õppeteed](https://moleculemaster.eu/): Learn about valence, bond counts, and molecular construction with six chemistry levels.
- [Labor](https://moleculemaster.eu/labor): Build your own molecules by selecting atoms and combining them.
- [Reaktsioonilabor](https://moleculemaster.eu/reaktsioonilabor): Conduct reaction experiments involving acids, bases, and catalysts.
- [Elementide Reaktsioonid](https://moleculemaster.eu/elementide-reaktsioonid): Learn about the reactivity of all 118 elements.
- [Intermolekulaarsed Jõud](https://moleculemaster.eu/intermolekulaarsed-joud): Explore various intermolecular forces in detail.
- [Kogumik](https://moleculemaster.eu/kogumik): Review and learn about different molecules and their properties.
- [Kvanttase](https://moleculemaster.eu/kvanttase): Understand electronic orbitals and electron configurations.
